subject: CAIQ synchronization roadmap & evidence pull
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@summitbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Whitfield <mark@consult-ops.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ sync: control mapping + artifacts we need

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. SummitBank is moving this CAIQ review into our vendor diligence sprint next month and we want to stitch Redwood's CAIQ responses to our internal control references. Two asks to start: 

1) A crosswalk (spreadsheet) with the CAIQ control ID, Redwood's short answer, and the owner for evidence. We prefer minimal columns: control_id, answer, evidence_owner, artifact_name.

2) A small set of artifacts demonstrating runtime telemetry and key rotation (we need something that shows token/key rotation cadence and a short runtime log sample for a production request).

Can you confirm owners and an ETA for a first-pass bundle? Also, our compliance lead Mark (cc'd) will join to ensure scope aligns.

Appreciate it — Elaine

--
Elaine Park
Senior Vendor Risk Lead | SummitBank
elaine.park@summitbank.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@summitbank.com>
Cc: Mark Whitfield <mark@consult-ops.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync: control mapping + artifacts we need

Hi Elaine / Mark — thanks for the note.

High-level plan: I can deliver a first-pass CAIQ crosswalk and a small evidence bundle by end of week (Friday 07/24). Proposed division of labor below so owners are clear:

- CAIQ crosswalk (control_id / concise answer / evidence_owner / artifact_name): Jordan Blake will assemble and export from our control registry.
- Runtime telemetry sample (sanitized logs): David Kim will pull a 24-hour sample, remove PII and tenant identifiers, and include a short README explaining what the fields show (latency, model_id, region tag).
- Key rotation evidence (HSM/KMS audit): Kimberly Park will export auth rotation logs and a short narrative on rotation cadence and KMS roles.

I will collate into a single zipped bundle and upload it to the evidence portal with links and a short README. Can you confirm the minimum acceptable formats (spreadsheet vs CSV vs CSV + narrative PDF) and whether DocuSign or access ticketing is needed for any of the attachments?

Attachments: none on this mail — I'll circulate the bundle when Jordan and team have their extracts.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.co le@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@summitbank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync: control mapping + artifacts we need

Thanks Elaine — looping in technical artifacts here. Quick notes on mapping approach so SummitBank's reviewers get predictable entries: 

- We'll use the CAIQ question IDs in the left column and keep answers intentionally concise (Yes/No/Partial + one-line qualifier). Long rationales live in a separate "rationale" tab to avoid overwhelming the main sheet.
- Evidence owner will be an internal contact (name + email) and a delivery ETA.
- For controls that span multiple systems (eg: tenant isolation + key management), we'll reference two artifacts (eg: runtime-telemetry-sample.zip + auth-rotation-log.txt).

ETA: I'll push the first-pass spreadsheet to SharePoint by EOD (07/20) and assign owners with expected upload windows.

Small ask for SummitBank: does your team have a required redaction checklist for logs (we redact all tenant IDs and IP-level PII by default, but some banks want hashed IDs or token-level mappings)? If you can share a short checklist I can tailor the sample accordingly.

Onwards — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Control Mapping Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@summitbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync: control mapping + artifacts we need

Hi Elaine — following up with the deliverables and access instructions.

We've uploaded a preliminary evidence bundle to our secure evidence portal: https://portal.redwood.com/evidence/REQ-719 (SummitBank has view-only access; link expires in 30 days). The package includes:

- caiq-control-crosswalk.xlsx (CAIQ ids, short answers, evidence_owner, artifact_name)
- auth-rotation-log.txt (sanitized KMS rotation entries, timestamps + roles)
- sample-runtime-logs.zip (24-hour runtime trace, tenant IDs masked per our standard redaction)
- README_SUMMITBANK.pdf (mapping notes, redaction summary, and contact list)

Attachment summary (for your intake): caiq-control-crosswalk.xlsx; auth-rotation-log.txt; sample-runtime-logs.zip

Access notes:
- If SummitBank needs hashed tenant IDs instead of masking, we can generate a second sample within 48 hours — please confirm.
- For any artefacts that need certificates or notarized attestation we can route through our compliance team and provide signed statements; let me know if that is required for your audit window.

I'll also create a short closure note in the bundle that traces which CAIQ controls are satisfied by which artifacts to help your reviewers.

Thanks, and happy to hop on a 30-min walkthrough this week if that helps expedite sign-off.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
